sections.Aims and Fit of Module: Diseases, like infectious disease and non-communicable diseases could affect individuals, families and the society. This module will provide Year 1 students the role of governments, health organizations, healthcare providers and patients in promoting health and preventing diseases.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Describe the basic function of healthcare system B. Discuss issues relating to ethics in healthcare C. Understand on a non-specialist level the causes, transmission and treatment of infectious diseases D. Demonstrate understanding of non-communicable diseases and the roles of governments, health organizations, healthcare providers and patients in combating these diseases.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Course content will be delivered primarily via standard lectures that will be accompanied by suitable lecture handouts (also available on LMO). Tutorials will be given as a platform to address any specific question or issue from students.
